definitions: Be deprived of or cease to have or retain (something).
Suffer a reduction in the amount or quality of.
Become unable to find (something or someone).
Fail to win (a game or contest).
Allow (something) to escape or be taken away.
Fail to take advantage of (an opportunity or advantage).
Be defeated in a contest or game.
Suffer the death of (a person, especially a relative or friend).
Get rid of (something unwanted or undesirable).
examples: I don't want to lose you.
Don't lose sight of your goals.
He lost his father last year.
I need to lose some weight.
We can't afford to lose time.
